description: This is a FastAPI Python source file that implements REST API endpoints for managing classification rules and applying classification/tagging to files. It defines routes for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting classification rules, as well as applying tags to files based on rules or manually. The file also contains helper functions for rule evaluation and nested value extraction.

classes.name: ClassificationRuleEntity
classes.description: Data model representing a classification rule, including its ID, description, conditions, and tags.

classes.name: RuleCreateEntity
classes.description: Data model for creating a new classification rule with description, conditions, and tags.

classes.name: RuleUpdateEntity
classes.description: Data model for updating an existing rule with optional description, conditions, and tags.

classes.name: ClassificationResultEntity
classes.description: Data model representing the result of classification/tagging, including filename and tags.

methods.name: create_rule( rule: RuleCreateEntity, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Creates a new classification rule with a generated UUID and stores it in the database.

methods.name: list_rules( db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all classification rules from the database.

methods.name: get_rule( rule_id: str, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific rule by rule_id.

methods.name: update_rule( rule_id: str, update: RuleUpdateEntity, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Updates an existing rule's description, conditions, or tags.

methods.name: delete_rule( rule_id: str, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Removes a rule identified by rule_id from the database.

methods.name: tag_file( filename: str = Body(..., embed=True, description="Filename to classify/tag"), tags: Optional[List[str]] = Body(None, embed=True, description="Manual tags; if omitted or empty, rules will be applied for tag assignment."), db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Assigns manual tags or applies rules to determine tags for a file, storing the result.

methods.name: classify_file_by_rules( filename: str = Body(..., embed=True, description="Filename to re-classify/tag"), db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Re-evaluates and updates tags for a file based on all rules applied to its parsed content.

methods.name: get_file_tags( filename: str, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Retrieves existing tags for a specific filename.

methods.name: _classify_by_rules(parsed_content, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase)
methods.description: Helper function that applies all classification rules to parsed content to determine tags.

methods.name: _evaluate_rule_conditions(conditions, parsed_content)
methods.description: Evaluates if a rule's conditions are satisfied by parsed content.

methods.name: _extract_nested_value(doc, dotfield)
methods.description: Supports nested key extraction from a dict using dot notation.

ctags.name: classify_file_by_rules
ctags.signature: ( filename: str = Body(..., embed=True, description="Filename to re-classify/tag"), db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )

ctags.name: tag_file
ctags.signature: ( filename: str = Body(..., embed=True, description="Filename to classify/tag"), tags: Optional[List[str]] = Body(None, embed=True, description="Manual tags; if omitted or empty, rules will be applied for tag assignment."), db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )

ctags.name: update_rule
ctags.signature: ( rule_id: str, update: RuleUpdateEntity, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database) )
